dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed 4-5 distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the posterior-lateral flank; perimeters exhibit a dark charcoal exterior gradient transitioning to a lighter slate-grey interior with irregular, diffuse edge boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters located on the anterior-dorsal ridge; mid-lateral section features a moderate density of larger, low-intensity dark pixel blobs lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent posterior annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a series of four high-intensity blobs on the anterior-dorsal ridge form a nearly linear sequence.
